name: Otsuki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Otsuki town emblem in green: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter M with a base.
history: Municipal flag of Otsuki, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1957.

features.role: Otsuki town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter M with a base
